import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the milestones list page by clicking the 'Milestones' link in the project navigation
    await page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Milestones").click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the page to load

    # Step 2: Click the 'New milestone' button on the milestones list page
    # Assuming the button has role "button" and name "New milestone"
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="New milestone").click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)

    # Step 3: Fill in the milestone details
    # Title input field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title").fill("Add zsh comprehensive support branch")
    
    # Start date input field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Start date").fill("2044-05-01")
    
    # Due date input field
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date").fill("2044-05-21")
    
    # Step 4: Click the 'Create milestone' button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create milestone").click()
    await asyncio.sleep(2)

    # Step 5: Return a result indicating success
    return "Milestone created successfully for adding zsh comprehensive support branch, starting on 5/1/2044 and ending on 5/21/2044."
